mapper.insert: insert into monitor_site_setting (site_code, next_rule_no, site_name, uds_site, timezone, currency, currency_symbol, is_default, sort_no, update_by, update_time) values (#{site.siteCode}, 1, #{site.siteName}, #{site.udsSite}, #{site.timezone}, #{site.currency}, #{site.currencySymbol}, #{site.defaultSite}, coalesce(#{site.sortNo}, (select coalesce(max(sort_no), 0) + 1 from monitor_site_setting)), #{site.updateBy}, localtimestamp) on conflict (site_code) do update set site_name = excluded.site_name, uds_site = excluded.uds_site, timezone = excluded.timezone, currency = excluded.currency, currency_symbol = excluded.currency_symbol, is_default = excluded.is_default, sort_no = excluded.sort_no, update_by = excluded.update_by, update_time = excluded.update_time where monitor_site_setting.site_name is null
mapper.update:
update monitor_site_setting set site_name = #{site.siteName}, uds_site = #{site.udsSite}, timezone = #{site.timezone}, currency = #{site.currency}, currency_symbol = #{site.currencySymbol}, sort_no = coalesce(#{site.sortNo}, sort_no),
site_code = #{newCode},
